katādhikāra.cp: (kata + adhikāra) adj. one who has formed a resolution or an aspiration.
katādhikāra.p: [Kata+adhikāra] (ti) CL=7 One who has made an aspiration (or) who has made an accumulation of merit.
a: ကတာဓိကာရ(တိ)

C: katādhikāra：[（kata + adhikāra） adj．] one who has formed a resolution or an aspiration．
K:
katādhikāra：ကတာဓိကာရ （တိ）
[ကတ+အဓိကာရ]
ပြုအပ်ပြီးသော လွန်ကဲသော ကုသိုလ်ကောင်းမှုအဆောက်အဦရှိသော၊ သူ။ အဓိကာရ-（၂）-ကြည့်။
R:
katādhikāra：ကတာဓိကာရ （တိ） （ကတ+အဓိကာရ）
ပြုအပ်ပြီးသော ကျေးဇူး ရှိသည်။
CPD: katâdhikāra , mfn. [kata + adhi°; cf. adhikārakata; sa. kṛtâdhikāra], 1. having done meritorious acts ( for the sake of someone or something; with loc. ); 2. having trained ( in something; with loc. ); — 1. ayaṃ hi ~o pacchimabhavikasatto paññāya itare satta jane a- bhibhavitvā, Ja l 56, 15 ; sūyati nu kho mahārāja eta- rahi Jinasāsane ~ānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavedanī- yaṃ kammaṃ, Mil 115, 6,9 ; ye sabbabuddhesu ~ā a- laddhamokkhā jinasāsanesu, Ap 7, 10 (= katapuñña- sambhārā jinasāsanesu aladdhamokkhā appattanib- bānā, Ap-a l 28, 30 ); purimabuddhesu dasapuññaki- riyavasena ~ā, Ps ll 177, 31 ; Mp l 144, 13 ; purima- Buddhesu dasapuññakiriyāvasena ~ā paripākagatā padumāni viya, Spk l 199, 13 ; purimabuddhesu ~o, Ud-a 123, 6 ; Dhp-a l 26, 6 = lll 469, 17 ; ayam pi puri- mabuddhesu ~o Atthadassissa Bhagavato kale ku- lagehe nibbattitvā, Th-a l 199, 3 ≠ 174, 11 ≠ Ap-a 295, 30 ≠ 451, 5 ; idha mahāpuriso ... purimakesu Buddhesu ~o, Cp-a 285, 26 ; — ° -tā , f. [ abstr. ] , the fact of having done meritorious acts; so mātu ekavacanen' eva ca pubbe ~āya (so read; Ee °aya) ca mātulatthe- rassa santikaṃ gantvā, Th-a l 63, 19 ; — ° -puggala- dassan'-atthaṃ , 2 ind., for the sake of looking at people who have done meritorious acts ( adv. acc. ); purima- Buddhānaṃ santike dānasīlâdivasena ~aṃ Bud- dhacakkunā lokaṃ oloketi, Sv 47, 35 = Mp l 66, 31 ; — 2. yo ca samathe akatādhikāro, tassa dukkhā paṭi- padā hoti, ~assa sukhā. yo pana vipassanāya akatā- dhikāro hoti, tassa dandhā abhiññā hoti, ~assa khippā, Vism 87, 19,21 ; yasmā suvisuddhesu nīlâdisu vaṇṇakasiṇesu tattha ~ānaṃ abhirativasena suṭṭhu adhimuccanaṭṭho sambhavati, Sv-pṭ ll 154, 6 ; — ° -tta , n . [ abstr. ] , the fact of having trained ( in some- thing; with loc. ); tattha ~ā indriyasaṃvare ukkaṃsa- pāramiṃ agamāsi, Ud-a 178, 13 , yāva upari kesantā samālokayamāno aṅgavijjāya katâdhikārattā dvat- tiṃsavaralakkhaṇasampattim assa ṅatvā, Pj ll 142, 10 ; 448, 10 .

katadaṇḍakamma.p: [Kata+daṇḍa+kamma] (ti) CL=7 One who has been punished.
a: ကတဒဏ္ဍကမ္မ(တိ)
ပြုအပ်သောဒဏ်အမှုရှိသော၊ ဒဏ်ပေးခံရသော၊ သူ။

CPD: kata-daṇḍa-kamma , mfn., having been punished; aññataro puriso kasāhato ~o bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti, Vin l 75, 29 foll. (= ettha yo vacanapesanâdīni a- karonto haññati, na so ~o, ... ayam eva te daṇḍo hotū ti, kasāhi haññati, ayaṃ kasāhato ~o, Sp 998, 25,26,28 ); aññataro puriso lakkhaṇāhato ~o bhik- khūsu pabbajito hoti, 76, 2 (= ettha katadaṇḍakam- mabhāvo purimanayen' eva veditabbo, Sp 999, 2 ); — ° -bhāva , m. [ abstr. of prec ] , the fact of having been punished; ~o, Sp 999, 2 ( ad Vin l 76, 2 , q.v. supra ).
